    for dr in range(-1, 2):

from collections import deque

def get_scattered_set(grid):
    scattered = set()
    visited = set()
    for r in range(len(grid)):
        for c in range(len(grid[0])):
            if grid[r][c] == bg and (r,c) not in visited:
                continue
            if (r,c) not in visited:
                q = deque([(r,c)])
                comp = [(r,c)]
                visited.add((r,c))
                while q:
                    cr, cc = q.popleft()
                    for dr, dc in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]:
                        nr, nc = cr+dr, cc+dc
                        npos = (nr,nc)
                        if 0 <= nr < len(grid) and 0 <= nc < len(grid[0]) and npos not in visited:

                                visited.add(npos)
                                comp.append(npos)
                                q.append(npos)

from collections import deque

def get_scattered(g, b):
    scattered = set()
    visited = set()
    for r in range(len(g)):
        for c in range(len(g[0])):
            if g[r][c] == b and (r,c) not in visited:
                continue
            if (r,c) not in visited:
                q = deque([(r,c)])
                comp = [(r,c)]
                visited.add((r,c))
                while q:
                    cr, cc = q.popleft()
                    for dr, dc in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]:
                        nr, nc = cr+dr, cc+dc
                        if 0 <= nr < len(g) and 0 <= nc < len(g[0]) and (nr,nc) not in visited:
                            if g[nr][nc] == g[cr][cc]:
                                visited.add((nr,nc))
                                comp.append((nr,nc))
                                q.append((nr,nc))
                if len(comp) == 1:
                    scattered.add((r,c))

def get_largest_component(g, b):

    largest_color = bg
    visited = set()
    for r in range(len(g)):

            if g[r][c] != b and (r,c) not in visited:
                q = deque([(r,c)])
                comp = [(r,c)]
                comp_color = g[r][c]
                visited.add((r,c))
                while q:
                    cr, cc = q.popleft()
                    for dr, dc in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]:
                        nr, nc = cr+dr, cc+dc
                        if 0 <= nr < len(g) and 0 <= nc < len(g[0]) and (nr,nc) not in visited:

                                visited.add((nr,nc))
                                comp.append((nr,nc))
                                q.append((nr,nc))
                if len(comp) > largest_size:
                    largest_size = len(comp)
                    largest_color = comp_color
    return largest_color
